newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to send aid to Iranian quake region.
newsitem.headline: Italy to send aid to Iranian quake region.

text.p: Italy said on Monday it was sending 36 tonnes of medicines and other emergency aid to Iran after a massive earthquake struck part of the country's eastern region, killing about 2,400 people and injuring 6,000.
A foreign ministry statement said the supplies, worth around 500 million lire ($300,000), would be flown to Tehran in the next few days.
Italy was also donating $30,000 to the World Health Organisation (WHO) for the purchase in Iran of health supplies, the statement said.
Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini has sent condolences to his Iranian counterpart Ali Akbar Velayati. He said Italy had been saddened by the tragic news of Saturday's quake.
